variables: The sensor in use (start: sensor_a) still gives new readings: its last_seq grew within the last 10 seconds.
The sensor in use has fewer than 60 readings (n < 60).
notes: Each sensor writes 1 reading each 2 seconds. n is the reading count, max_t is the highest temperature, last_seq is the newest seq. Start with sensor_a. If sensor_a gives no new reading for 10 seconds or more, use sensor_b. The work ends when the sensor in use has n >= 60. The answer is max_t of that sensor.
